header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: and each one of them asked up to the furthest limit of his desires, no decrease would occur in My treasures, not even as much as when a person going to the seashore dips a needle into the sea and takes it out. This is because I am the Most Generous, I am the Most Noble; My giving is but a word. When I intend something, I say to it (Kun) “Be,' and at once it is,” says Allah Ta'ala.” Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: مَنِ اسْتَغْفَرَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ كَتَبَ اللهُ لَهُ بِكُلِّ مُؤْمِنٍ وَمُؤْمِنَةٍ حَسَنَةً.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني واسناده جيد مجمع الزوائد:٣٥٢/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ubadah ibn Samit (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “Whoever seeks forgiveness for the believing men and the believing women, Allah Ta'ala writes for him one good deed in return for each believing man and woman.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِذَا الْتَقَي الْمُسْلِمَانِ فَتَصَافَحَا وَحَمِدَا اللهَ وَاسْتَغْفَرَاهُ غُفِرَ لَهُمَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في المصافحة رقم:٥٢١١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Bara' ibn Azib (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “When two Muslims meet, shake hands (Musafahah), praise Allah Ta'ala and ask Allah Ta'ala for forgiveness, saying (اَلْحَمْدُ للهِ يَغْفِرُ الله لَنَا وَ لَكُمْ), they are granted forgiveness.”
